QuestInfo.name: [Water Wars] Secret Mission: Blast Belle!
QuestInfo.0: It's a SECRET MISSION! Speak with Neinheart at the Cygnus Knights Hideout.
QuestInfo.1: Secret mission, here we go! Infiltrate Edelstein and blast key Resistance members with your Hydroblaster. But beware, the mission will fail if you are caught by the patrolling soldiers!
QuestInfo.2: Mission accomplished! You infiltrated Edelstein and blasted key Resistance members with your Hydroblaster!
